title: Attentional agency is a phenomenal property, absent in non-lucid dreams

statements.text: Attentional agency is the conscious experience of initiating a shift of attention and fixing its focus. It is selectively missing in non-lucid dreaming and likely in infancy, dementia and severe intoxication. It is fully transparent, and under predictive coding it can be linked to precision optimization, the modeling of mental resource allocation.
